text:
sarah: Following up on INC-438 postmortem action items 1 — a couple are overdue. Please drop quick status updates here. Owners: @ajay (AJ-12), @mike (MK-07), @emily (EM-05).

sarah: Items copied in: 
```
- AJ-12: router retry/backoff fix (owner: ajay)  target 2026-03-10
- MK-07: autoscale thresholds + guardrails (owner: mike)  target 2026-03-12
- EM-05: KV cache eviction alert with sample traces (owner: emily)  target 2026-03-14
```

oncall-bot: AUTO: INC-438 remediation overdue notice sent to owners: ajay, mike, emily.

ajay: AJ-12 status: PR opened but hitting a flaky test. I have a small refactor to stabilize it. ETA tomorrow morning. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/router/pull/142

mike: MK-07 status: blocked on missing dimension from metrics exporter. Filed INF-684. Waiting on eng-infra to add dimension. I can land thresholds once that's available, otherwise will add a temporary threshold this week.

emily: EM-05 done and deployed to staging. Added alert + sample trace payload on alert. Commit: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/commit/7a1b2c3

sarah: Thanks. Two requests: 1) paste the PR/commit link here when merged, 2) update the internal PM tracker doc with status (in case of ownership handoff).

lei: If either AJ-12 or MK-07 are still blocked after 48h, we'll temporarily reassign to keep momentum. Please flag if you need reassignment.

ajay: PR merged: commit 3f4e1b2. Added deterministic backoff + unit test. https://git.internal/r/redwood/router/commit/3f4e1b2 (1773014400)

mike: eng-infra delivered the metric late afternoon. I pushed a temp threshold earlier: https://git.internal/r/redwood/ops/commit/55b2aa9. I'll replace it with a proper rule in MK-07-epic once infra changes are live.

sarah: Verified AJ-12 commit and EM-05. Mike, once you replace the temp threshold, reply here with the final commit and I'll mark MK-07 remediated.

emily: noted. I'll update the PM tracker now.

lei: Closing process note: I'll mark INC-438 remediations as verified once all three have final links in this thread and tracker is updated. If something regresses, reopen the incident or create INF-... and ping #incidents.

sarah: Great work, thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:

oncall-bot: NOTE: INC-438 remediation status changed to "in-progress" -> "verified" by lei (1773014600).
